answer_1.quote: Neural abstractive summarization has witnessed rapid growth in recent years.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE-1 (unigram), ROUGE-2 (bigram), and ROUGE-L (LCS) F1 scores as the evaluation metrics, which are most commonly used evaluation metrics in the summarization task.

answer_4.quote: We ask five volunteers to evaluate the quality of the generated summaries from the following three aspects: (1) Informative: how much does the generated summaries cover the key content of the source text? (2) Conciseness: how concise are the generated summaries? (3) Fluency: how fluent are the generated summaries?
